scope: The mapped former PX goods shed occupied by the Outeniqua Transport Museum in George. Excludes the separate historic station, surrounding buildings, tracks and collection objects.

originalReview.notes: Oblique rail side: visible upper panels and edge flashing only. The train and lower facade do not inform the model.

quallaSearch.notes: The published Qualla original was checked first. The exact bytes are the sole native first upload. The author’s original self-made public-domain release uses the former account name, which Commons redirects to the current uploader. The image is useful for siding and eaves only; the rolling stock and other imagery were excluded.
